about: The Harmony 300's test setup, todo-compile-300.md 3.4: what Logitech's service compiled for the bench 300's record, section 265, the configuration the unit holds and the lab keeps as h300_programmed_config. One device per device key: the Panasonic television on TV, the KPN box on Cable/Sat, the Panasonic DVD player on DVD and the Sony video recorder on VCR/Aux; Watch TV as Logitech set it up, toggling the KPN's and the television's power and ending in the KPN's mode; four favourite channels on the KPN, entered as 1, 2, 3 and 666. Which device goes on which key is not part of this file's format. The record holds no devices any more; the compile is the reference.
